sub_site: peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC), gastrointestinal cancer patients on chemo/immunotherapy

evidence.quote: A total of 164 samples were obtained from these patients before and after treatment
The variable regions (V3–V4) of the 16S rRNA gene were sequenced to assess the blood and fecal microbiomes.
The Lactobacillus gene copy number in the blood was quantified using absolute bacterial quantification via quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR).

notes: 164 PBMC 16S samples (80 discovery + 84 validation set 1); validation set 2 (30) by Lactobacillus-specific qPCR only, so biomass_qpcr set 'no' (genus-specific, not total load). Mouse experiments ignored. No negative controls mentioned; Ralstonia/Pseudomonas/Cutibacterium among top genera not discussed as contaminants. Primary tumours are GI (non-target) but sample is blood.
